questions.prompt: Which description distinguishes a pendentive from a squinch when supporting a dome over a square space?

choices.text: A curved triangular surface joining the dome to corner supports

questions.hint: Picture the geometry left between a circular dome base and the arches beneath it.
questions.explanation: A pendentive is a spherical triangular transition. A squinch instead spans a corner with an arch, niche, or related construction.
